=== PUBLIC TURN 2/2 ===
## Gate: `NO_GO`

The refund-posting API is not ready for implementation. This decision follows authoritative policy and reproducible evidence—not reviewer count or internal-network placement.

Critical blockers:

- `DELETE /ledger/{entry_id}` contradicts the confirmed append-only ledger policy.
- `POST /refunds` lacks server-side authorization, and `support_agent` successfully creates a posted entry in `tests/refund_contract_test.php::support_token_posts_refund`, reproduced 3/3.
- Caller-supplied `actor_id` permits untrusted actor attribution.
- Undefined idempotency permits duplicate permanent refund postings.

Required before re-review:

- Remove destructive ledger deletion; define an append-only correction mechanism.
- Derive actor identity from the authenticated principal.
- Enforce `finance_approver` authorization before any ledger mutation.
- Define atomic idempotency and replay/conflict behavior.
- Add tests proving approver success, support-agent denial with no ledger effect, trusted attribution, one entry across retries, and deletion prohibition.

The prior `GO` rationale is rejected: network location and future remediation do not satisfy current confirmed policy or negate the reproduced authorization bypass.

| ID | Disposition | Sources | Evidence locator |
|---|---|---|---|
| I1 Ledger deletion | Accepted blocker | `rr-accounting-controls-v1`, `rr-api-readiness-v1` | Policy: append-only; draft `DELETE /ledger/{entry_id}` |
| I2 Authorization bypass | Accepted blocker | all three roles | Policy; draft `POST /refunds`; `support_token_posts_refund` |
| I3 Actor spoofing | Accepted high | all three roles | `POST /refunds` caller-supplied `actor_id` |
| I4 Duplicate posting | Accepted high | `rr-accounting-controls-v1`, `rr-api-readiness-v1` | `POST /refunds` lacks idempotency |
| I5 Verification gap | Accepted high | `rr-api-readiness-v1` | Current test validates forbidden success |
